_doc: Goods hung from the store's beaded ceiling (#1182 G3, bolder in #1192 G4): six cured hams in muslin on tarred cord from a rail, hung at two lengths. A prop that hangs by a hook (GlassProp, as the hanging lamp: it swings when pushed, and falls whole if the board it hangs from goes; its parts never shatter). Baked the gun way (tools/blender/props/store_g3.py: model hung_ham). Written by tools/props/store_g3.py.
